dashboard.title: Your dashboard
dashboard.startOnboarding: Start: tell us about your skill

skill.question: What can you do, or what would you love to learn?
skill.placeholder: In your own words — Bangla or English. For example: I make logos for my cousin's shop.

platform.question: Where do you want to earn first?
platform.fiverrHint: You publish services (gigs); buyers come to you.
platform.upworkHint: You send proposals to posted jobs.

hours.question: How many hours a week can you really give?

english.question: How comfortable are you writing to clients in English?
english.lowHint: Atlas will draft client messages with you, step by step.
english.mediumHint: You'll get templates and gentle corrections.

experience.question: Have you done paid work with this skill before?
experience.noneHint: Perfect — the roadmap starts from zero.
experience.someHint: Friends, family, or a few small jobs.
experience.experiencedHint: We'll focus on getting you online and scaling.

onboarding.error: Saving failed. Your answers are still here — try again.

coach.title: Atlas, your coach
coach.subtitle: Ask anything about your path — Bangla or English. Atlas answers platform questions only from verified notes.
coach.empty: Say hello, or ask what to do next.
coach.dailyCap: You've used today's free coaching time. Atlas will be back tomorrow — meanwhile, your roadmap missions are waiting.
coach.error: Something broke on our side. Try again in a moment.

roadmap.title: Your 90-day roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: Phase by phase, mission by mission — boss missions unlock the next phase.

home.title: Welcome to LaunchPilot
home.intro: A coach, not a course. Atlas walks you step by step to your first real earning — honestly, in your language.
home.status: The walking skeleton is under construction. Every layer you see here is wired end to end.
